recognize_zh: 未染色的頭髮毛幹在光學顯微鏡下，黑色素沿髓質與皮質呈細長條狀、連續且均勻分布，看不到格里塞利症候群（Griscelli syndrome）特有的大型不規則色素團塊；這張是作為對照的正常色素型態。
features: Unstained hair shaft examined by light microscopy
Melanin pigment distributed as fine, continuous longitudinal streaks along the shaft
Pigment appears evenly spaced without large irregular clumps
No small regularly spaced giant granules as seen in Chediak-Higashi syndrome
Shaft contour intact without structural hair abnormalities; clear background
describe_en: Light microscopy of an unstained hair shaft shows melanin pigment distributed as fine, evenly spaced longitudinal streaks along the length of the shaft. No large irregular pigment clumps or regularly spaced enlarged granules are identified, and the shaft contour is intact. This represents an evenly distributed pigment pattern, which serves as the comparison for the large irregular pigment clumps that characterize Griscelli syndrome type 2 in the case.

ddx.vs: Griscelli hair shows large, irregular clumps of pigment unevenly distributed, mainly in the medulla, rather than fine even streaks.
Chediak-Higashi hair contains small, regularly distributed enlarged melanin granules, and blood leukocytes show giant cytoplasmic granules.
Elejalde syndrome has large irregular pigment clumps similar to Griscelli but with primary neurologic disease and no HLH.
